description:
Robust High-Carbon Steel Frame

The sturdy steel frame offers high durability and resistance, ideal for challenging terrain and long rides.

18 Speed Drivetrain for More Control

The smooth 18-speed drivetrain enables precise gear changes, so you can always choose the right speed for your route.

Dual Disc Brakes

Equipped with mechanical disc brakes front and rear for strong braking power and safety, even in difficult weather conditions or fast descents.

Suspension Fork for More Comfort

The shock-absorbing suspension fork absorbs bumps and ensures a pleasant riding experience on bumpy roads or off-road tracks.

Smooth City Commutes

Versatile: Perfect for men and women, ideal for riding in the city, on forest trails or in the mountains. This unisex mountain bike offers reliable performance for every adventure.

Elevate your adventure with the Hiland Ridge 2 Mountain Bike. Featuring a high-performance suspension fork, 21-speed drivetrain, and dual disc brakes for ultimate trail control. Shop now!
